explicit_requirements: When a seat is available, move one waiting attendee to the enrolled list and return the selected ID.
Promotion must not exceed class capacity.
When no seat is available or nobody is waiting, leave the class unchanged and report no promotion.
Promotion must work with regular and priority members.
ambiguities: The selection policy among multiple waiting attendees is unspecified, including whether priority members take precedence over regular members and how ties are resolved.

scenarios.name: Fill one vacancy from the waiting list
scenarios.behavior: When space and waiting attendees exist, exactly one waiting attendee moves to enrolled and the returned ID identifies that attendee; enrollment remains within capacity. Do not assume which attendee is selected when several are waiting.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires one transfer, the selected ID, and the capacity limit, but supplies no selection policy.

scenarios.name: Leave a full class unchanged
scenarios.behavior: When enrollment has reached capacity, promotion leaves the class unchanged and reports no attendee promoted.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires no change or promotion when no seat exists.

scenarios.name: Leave a class with no waiting attendees unchanged
scenarios.behavior: When the waiting list is empty, promotion leaves the class unchanged and reports no attendee promoted.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly specifies unchanged state and no promotion when nobody is waiting.

scenarios.name: Support both membership types
scenarios.behavior: With a vacancy and a single waiting attendee, promotion works for a regular member and for a priority member.
scenarios.reason: The task directly requires support for both kinds of membership; a single candidate avoids assuming an unstated priority policy.
